card.name: Start of Dal- and Sur- words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning with Dal or Sur, such as Dalbavancin, Dalmane, Dalai, Dalrymple, surmount and SURVANTA. It fires on the opening piece before the rest of the word is written.
